name: mirage
text: Sorry for the wait. 1) Hard block: v1.0.136 is released. It blocks by-hand bets on proven losers everywhere except the NCAAB tab, where you can bet anything. 2) Settings: I compared your phone's latest copy with my 19:03 one and nothing differs. Bid deploy is on at 100%, many-small-bids is on, trading is LIVE. 3) Bids: I read the engine log just now, and the wallet has money. The desk is not limited by cash. It has only 6-16 bids resting (-20) because it posts a few and takes most down the next pass, so they never build up. I am digging into why they are pulled, then I'll fix it for volume and tell you what I changed.
